summary:
• Claude Haiku 5.5 — Anthropic's new fast, low‑cost LLM offering higher reasoning quality at the cheapest token price for typical workloads.
• EmbeddingGemma 2 — an open‑source, on‑device multimodal embedder that unifies text, code, images, video and audio for privacy‑first retrieval without cloud costs.
• Strands‑decider — a system‑one decision model that scores options faster than full LLMs, enabling lightweight branching logic in autonomous agents, especially on Apple‑silicon Macs.
• Whirl — a self‑hosted full‑stack AI chat app built with Next.js and Convex that lets users combine modular model, memory, and plug‑in features via API keys.
• Codex Rust — the Rust client for Codex adds managed Git worktree tools, pinned task groups, and UI enhancements to streamline multi‑repo development.
• Anthropic OSS Scanner — a free service that runs periodic vulnerability scans on open‑source repositories using Anthropic's models, providing automated reports for early security insight.
